Temporal focus:
T1. Historical report [NO]
T2. Forward-looking reporting short-term risks (next few weeks/months) [YES]

Synopsis:
Reuters risk-event roundup ahead of September. Key themes: Iran war driving oil/inflation/bond volatility; Fed (Sep 16) and BOJ (Sep 18) meetings in the same week with hawkish lean from new Fed Chair Warsh; Anthropic IPO potentially ~$1T valuation stressing AI trade and tech stocks; European fiscal risks (France budget, German state elections, UK Burnham government); US midterms pressuring Trump admin on gas prices and long-end Treasury rates.

Q01. Is the content relevant to US economy, US yields, US interest rates and US market pricing?
Relevance: YES

Q02. Is the content about increasing US interest rates?
Relevance: 80 (HIGH)
Probability of increase: 70%

Q03. Is the content about holding stable US interest rates?
Relevance: 20 (LOW)
Probability of holding: 25%

Q04. Is the content about decreasing US interest rates?
Relevance: 5 (VERY LOW)
Probability of decrease: 5%

Q05. Focus on the very latest information: What is the sentiment/tone including the very latest information on US interest rates?
Sentiment: 70 (MORE HAWKISH) — Warsh's Jackson Hole speech flagged as hawkish, Sep 16 hike expectations firming, Treasury intervention muddying signals but not offsetting the hawkish lean; countervailing political pressure from midterms on long-end rates is a modest dovish offset.
